[QUERENT] IPTC photo metadata

[SYSTEM] You can explore the official [IPTC Photo Metadata Standard](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVgRF_fxxfUoaWdjEmJnXOZUi2mo9AXD-jVEu2IjmL-Wvj_9DMkof04xcPAjsAtWDsUbxAgfu9s_ueEl-GBbSNqzO20Sw3PHeK1jaO3Xww-EWyREarSRCOFKNO33s5) to manage, describe, and protect digital images. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVgRF_fxxfUoaWdjEmJnXOZUi2mo9AXD-jVEu2IjmL-Wvj_9DMkof04xcPAjsAtWDsUbxAgfu9s_ueEl-GBbSNqzO20Sw3PHeK1jaO3Xww-EWyREarSRCOFKNO33s5), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHrOzAV7usxs9KziO3nXUUjKjLTBtkkXLxpaQ5q-LQ-iC9DAREpVxSUSE4jssaCo7hyXqvHln3UxuGypW2zw5nIH1UbihD4oVeYACNc4Ay7PTwWp73ek4aDjMfKgtiztN4EC4G4R7lxzRv2bPxFqNxPoqFma3g1qGzukw4XmA)]
What is IPTC Photo Metadata?

* Definition: A universally accepted industry standard for embedding administrative, descriptive, and copyright data directly into image files. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHrOzAVa6YL90vCdRk54bfdCqyuYvh4CEovCdFgLnEYnW3vbq09ZsykzLkAgXLUGErTkcuY4uCsxb8pXorV__XOQ0JcYHG2Kgd9ZbyoOqFJqcBn9xqzDUyjQakZoE014-xIBDq1rPZXnhrwS1gzyAN-Qx02xwej), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVgRF_fxxfUoaWdjEmJnXOZUi2mo9AXD-jVEu2IjmL-Wvj_9DMkof04xcPAjsAtWDsUbxAgfu9s_ueEl-GBbSNqzO20Sw3PHeK1jaO3Xww-EWyREarSRCOFKNO33s5)]
* File Formats: Supported across formats like JPEG, TIFF, and PNG, using the [IPTC Core and Extension Schemas](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHrOzAVamozPSLuGtmUTmGz7WwmcSatTV8gSXhP-9rIadeE0o5ppLComWGrJdrdV7r9w8ZPg5AcHt7iiTBh6iqnkKCyxuIZn7Zu32WsAykDeM_t3-KZ1Bf5tz_TdNJ6qLmpFvAlGMzKRlW10KxlAkU) as well as Adobe's XMP framework. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHrOzAVamozPSLuGtmUTmGz7WwmcSatTV8gSXhP-9rIadeE0o5ppLComWGrJdrdV7r9w8ZPg5AcHt7iiTBh6iqnkKCyxuIZn7Zu32WsAykDeM_t3-KZ1Bf5tz_TdNJ6qLmpFvAlGMzKRlW10KxlAkU), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAVmh2LShS5MWI7zNanQK48Fy09v-FUYv2fnKOl9Q60zl7NWCKFzXzvAmw_B7hv4YRIkFhcV9ZArqAfLAqhCWvoKppUBtuwrHTa-1FfSdQFDP1Sw-D_tVVoLSju-14i-JNEDTa0OM5CTjm3leteOr04ZieTEQ)]
* Difference from EXIF: While EXIF focuses on technical camera data (shutter speed, ISO, lens settings), IPTC focuses on human-readable details like captions, keywords, and creator credits. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHrOzAV4OaxjMInbnBsTfDNBVPuyfZx3qG_QPAwuA6FUkdWDuhM_hqnEFFXY5HEDP898osmd5eS4Ij5o2s2AvZGP6VBhWtbdEhffhRZTSpOgTS09pI8vTSo1CkN7JlsP-t5GgAO74Oqz2ULN4-gv533xk5Hge5IQL3z66HzPaE)]

Main Metadata Categories

* Descriptive: Includes Alt Text, Headline, Description/Caption, Keywords, and Subject Codes.
* Administrative: Tracks Creation Date, Digital Source Type, Image GUIDs, and registry IDs.
* Rights & Ownership: Stores Creator (Photographer), Copyright Notice, Licensor, and usage terms.
* AI & Content Provenance: Recent standards (such as version 2025.1) include fields for AI System Used, AI System Version, AI Prompt Information, and AI Prompt Writer Name. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEB6zswFQqPeUMQGV4DdPP7rGUYInuL_LeQuNpiALiUM1bR4IKTJ1rbBFQbcJ_NOqs-g47BgnGnqgaqK5AbUrKuBPZT07T1JmrYBIW5jnrXCwCsozsVyqe1TIiug-6v0v--DpDZvQxWT72pKnr0M-AW97JJJU3qz_0-7ndVehk6RgCvfLSs), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHrOzAV7usxs9KziO3nXUUjKjLTBtkkXLxpaQ5q-LQ-iC9DAREpVxSUSE4jssaCo7hyXqvHln3UxuGypW2zw5nIH1UbihD4oVeYACNc4Ay7PTwWp73ek4aDjMfKgtiztN4EC4G4R7lxzRv2bPxFqNxPoqFma3g1qGzukw4XmA), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHrOzAVa6YL90vCdRk54bfdCqyuYvh4CEovCdFgLnEYnW3vbq09ZsykzLkAgXLUGErTkcuY4uCsxb8pXorV__XOQ0JcYHG2Kgd9ZbyoOqFJqcBn9xqzDUyjQakZoE014-xIBDq1rPZXnhrwS1gzyAN-Qx02xwej)]

Key Use Cases

* Digital Asset Management (DAM): Helps archives, news agencies, and stock libraries search and sort massive libraries.
* Search & Google Images: Search engines read embedded IPTC data to display creator information and licensing attributes directly in search results.
* Verification Tools: You can inspect embedded data using tools like the IPTC Photo Metadata Inspector or [GetPMD](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEB6zswFX_cDHQzffcNEF4kmRPyTooc9ZbD15prAJjD2bYe8d6VDdT1V80N9wR4nkcUAYvu4ovpP45OwUkvDYbMb_rZDZxkP7FDXQDQ1emANvOy4NTaIdW11XV41DQVdwTBbX0sr9NVrLZ8I-2nF7XwbVlerxrFu-gtuJ37yqAxpsA5KhUbp-2rMGyfejNn49aGJkXu). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHrOzAVRTuJN3uvMPelKOVezxw9MlvKudO3GIa_js0R6tGqRdefnGcMQHYIaKQBCvfeQkm3D24fN6OaT_aVvTxeUVfbO-7ERdV3UxHaUkeP8DcCHqf_rXtt2YVQTMMiStZqZ1NpyhcmlmYY8r3RAmNp0P8syA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVpQCmpGd1VSONuWLPH6zOZdwPXJuXoMuMGb_-xkShiGxn-SgZDGD4MvW02CeFNDu4kwMR6WIzJ7bkyONM_w4FvDTUZqeYR8gfExzyCbHT8Wj0Jodl1Kdwrl-pB5ACYLS4WpV_JA), [3](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/iptc-photo-metadata-inspe/ejadeefikdifbfnhokdodfphhkimbelb), [4](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEB6zswFX_cDHQzffcNEF4kmRPyTooc9ZbD15prAJjD2bYe8d6VDdT1V80N9wR4nkcUAYvu4ovpP45OwUkvDYbMb_rZDZxkP7FDXQDQ1emANvOy4NTaIdW11XV41DQVdwTBbX0sr9NVrLZ8I-2nF7XwbVlerxrFu-gtuJ37yqAxpsA5KhUbp-2rMGyfejNn49aGJkXu), [5](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVgRF_fxxfUoaWdjEmJnXOZUi2mo9AXD-jVEu2IjmL-Wvj_9DMkof04xcPAjsAtWDsUbxAgfu9s_ueEl-GBbSNqzO20Sw3PHeK1jaO3Xww-EWyREarSRCOFKNO33s5), [6](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHrOzAV4OaxjMInbnBsTfDNBVPuyfZx3qG_QPAwuA6FUkdWDuhM_hqnEFFXY5HEDP898osmd5eS4Ij5o2s2AvZGP6VBhWtbdEhffhRZTSpOgTS09pI8vTSo1CkN7JlsP-t5GgAO74Oqz2ULN4-gv533xk5Hge5IQL3z66HzPaE)]

[QUERENT] Nanopublications

[SYSTEM] A nanopublication is the smallest independent unit of publishable scientific information, represented as a machine-readable knowledge graph snippet rather than a traditional research paper. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTAHrOzAV1yR1C6Ffp-mJYbjicBIQjplNbIkm1DPUmGjplHWIHrhfd_KnQTn3nZnd2etExBDERCfJkZKv2Clw6GjnOCm6jj2nsx-gVZk), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHrOzAVHHcCYMwchIQdtXG0q8p-tpdrN_-MS1SXUpFnut9sAtEfFkWgmGqLulEfczlsfUNnpcIseOQtly0ECDQBG4tTkw_cojKjZMk9SO20C4MEHaBgXz5rp7zoyFo0wfGsWBmJYw)]
Core Structure
Every nanopublication is built using Resource Description Framework (RDF) triples and consists of three mandatory parts: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVT30WsgNwtI0KXwg-_GIDeC5PLJF7UcX4OWuVacfZntN8sGCKhu_7lSqiGmWLb3sW8xyBUQG_eTof3qFedDl4gD92_ZbHpAfCK6j8muKPrwMO03aveO5z0Uf3OrVVbsLSQASaFQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEB6zswFWE5BZijtwjt9Re1Ur-t_mG0A6ZZI1r4t95onFRxZig5Ms8nYV8IwXXBF50xNEFX5VodqJNMvhnh3TVRki9wmjjlRbX1ICuuWk1Wq8xlFBYMI4vrgfMwrv1C33E2_10RMAIeLdayTF-FqKjknWkHf1US3qfyZT_APb0EraRhahBSZ_k)]

* Assertion: A single, atomic scientific statement or claim (e.g., a specific relation between a gene and a disease). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTAHrOzAV1yR1C6Ffp-mJYbjicBIQjplNbIkm1DPUmGjplHWIHrhfd_KnQTn3nZnd2etExBDERCfJkZKv2Clw6GjnOCm6jj2nsx-gVZk), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEB6zswFWE5BZijtwjt9Re1Ur-t_mG0A6ZZI1r4t95onFRxZig5Ms8nYV8IwXXBF50xNEFX5VodqJNMvhnh3TVRki9wmjjlRbX1ICuuWk1Wq8xlFBYMI4vrgfMwrv1C33E2_10RMAIeLdayTF-FqKjknWkHf1US3qfyZT_APb0EraRhahBSZ_k)]
* Provenance: Metadata detailing how the assertion was generated, including the methods, parameters, and primary source or paper. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEB6zswFb3rkEAMLJU3gbOi0LNmRqtOJ4t07gTM0nmJ59PZ-Q_kHqif2vF3lIGgQI5CsWF4B3fjajhGO5UGTin5prWH77KCf2F1WMQcVCI0YB-6NbFTClr_OZ4BZVrF2tsFlG7-dGyuRMW4zXDjlgWGh6APKxek81WB0kD_SG9c5ftYWHrT), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEB6zswFWE5BZijtwjt9Re1Ur-t_mG0A6ZZI1r4t95onFRxZig5Ms8nYV8IwXXBF50xNEFX5VodqJNMvhnh3TVRki9wmjjlRbX1ICuuWk1Wq8xlFBYMI4vrgfMwrv1C33E2_10RMAIeLdayTF-FqKjknWkHf1US3qfyZT_APb0EraRhahBSZ_k)]
* Publication Info: Metadata identifying the creator, creation timestamp, and reuse or licensing terms. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEB6zswFWE5BZijtwjt9Re1Ur-t_mG0A6ZZI1r4t95onFRxZig5Ms8nYV8IwXXBF50xNEFX5VodqJNMvhnh3TVRki9wmjjlRbX1ICuuWk1Wq8xlFBYMI4vrgfMwrv1C33E2_10RMAIeLdayTF-FqKjknWkHf1US3qfyZT_APb0EraRhahBSZ_k)]

[[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVgms_ESOyHhe1D0kETAdvLhlfTSZSqGbiiS0TIUDdgAqEf3qpe-ByJYOTGx1ji1SsDDlVDzXKZzBQYdVtbZZ0FbJ04coryqRDcGSfdgwimQIVGpk49t8HHDc6nI43aLp_ka5ejQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVU01FbKjqKLFYWTaNiZYplQ8UQ-cTMSNBjPF8nqEl2y9--9eB-WyrqaP046sOGs1WcXCz5z-vjxbFnIGx2wjxuo7Qo5Q8WmHtkKQlAa5EjDFmUSFi31CF9mMLgtKU2HaYdleBfg)]
* Core Task: It measures whether every claim generated by an LLM is fully and accurately supported by its cited reference evidence (classified as `attributable` or `not attributable`). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHrOzAVpZlERTl75IWAAC9-thaAFB3DX_b_T81TUeWKlJZW4_YdoOcnA7wZoHkgXY3Zhbc2_YPw_zVIs-_knsuf7b3o6gPpZYjI3KpLPpPMDvadBfybX5T3dwU_ZEBc_-QNEra_4O0), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVgms_ESOyHhe1D0kETAdvLhlfTSZSqGbiiS0TIUDdgAqEf3qpe-ByJYOTGx1ji1SsDDlVDzXKZzBQYdVtbZZ0FbJ04coryqRDcGSfdgwimQIVGpk49t8HHDc6nI43aLp_ka5ejQ)]
* Dataset Availability: The dataset and code are open-sourced via the [Hugging Face AttributionBench Dataset](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHrOzAVNHLVxrI2cQf_XAnHqx_nRxad9fjvo47I43P_6udYsZree37Tf4h0ThugpBuyHFG3GeSlRkiVwIcWexDwXVFexctl11F4y0phY62RZFAdTEAa6oiODlBMLLZghaBGvVilCCYxJBbUecAC_Q) and the [GitHub Repository](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVgms_ESOyHhe1D0kETAdvLhlfTSZSqGbiiS0TIUDdgAqEf3qpe-ByJYOTGx1ji1SsDDlVDzXKZzBQYdVtbZZ0FbJ04coryqRDcGSfdgwimQIVGpk49t8HHDc6nI43aLp_ka5ejQ). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHrOzAVNHLVxrI2cQf_XAnHqx_nRxad9fjvo47I43P_6udYsZree37Tf4h0ThugpBuyHFG3GeSlRkiVwIcWexDwXVFexctl11F4y0phY62RZFAdTEAa6oiODlBMLLZghaBGvVilCCYxJBbUecAC_Q), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVgms_ESOyHhe1D0kETAdvLhlfTSZSqGbiiS0TIUDdgAqEf3qpe-ByJYOTGx1ji1SsDDlVDzXKZzBQYdVtbZZ0FbJ04coryqRDcGSfdgwimQIVGpk49t8HHDc6nI43aLp_ka5ejQ)]

* High Difficulty for LLMs: Even cutting-edge models like GPT-4 and fine-tuned GPT-3.5 face significant limitations, reaching only around 80% macro-F1 score on binary attribution classification tasks (and dropping to 60–70% or lower on complex, long-evidence, or out-of-domain datasets). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVU01FbKjqKLFYWTaNiZYplQ8UQ-cTMSNBjPF8nqEl2y9--9eB-WyrqaP046sOGs1WcXCz5z-vjxbFnIGx2wjxuo7Qo5Q8WmHtkKQlAa5EjDFmUSFi31CF9mMLgtKU2HaYdleBfg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVmqv2rMzE2fwWGexH4ZP2TmOPFx1x4yOBvoEDc5-2uk21FgRGxqSTveJLXNIK9i_jG2EfxOjIDd-0iwHArcW44frlGDmFVP3i31HMP1TN30TmK00)]
